title: Adjudication Load
definition: The number of decisions handed back to the practitioner per loop or audit round: findings, framing questions, grounding actions, held-open readings. Grows with loop depth. Distinct from reading load: making each item cheaper to read does not reduce the count. The methodology's existing bounds (Convergence-Saturation Signal; patch-switching) limit rounds and loops, not items per round. Reduced by Pre-Triage.
product_origin: "loops peel back more layers of the onion that need more adjudication by the reader. So it's exhausting" (Solo Developer, 2026-09-03)
aliases: gate fatigue (both conflate count with cost)
